itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the spell Find Familiar that summons a small spider.
itens.descricao: Summon a spider familiar with a poisonous Bite (Spider) Bite.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a sphere of fog on an area in range and heavily obscure the area. Creatures within the area are Blinded.
itens.descricao: Create a cloud of dense fog to Heavily Obscured Heavily Obscure and Blinded Blind creatures within.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When this spell is cast at 2nd level or higher, its area of effect increases by dist for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to create magical berries which have healing properties when eaten.
itens.descricao:
Conjure four magical berries for yourself or a companion. Creatures who eat a berry regain 1d4 Healing.
Each berry counts as one Camp Supplies.
The berries appear in the targeted creature's inventory and disappear after a Long Rest.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to conjure flammable grease on the ground within range and turn it into Difficult Terrain.
itens.descricao: Cover the ground in flammable grease. It becomes Difficult Terrain and creatures within can fall Prone.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with a bolt that deals Radiant damage and grants advantage to the next attack roll made against them.
itens.descricao: The next attack roll against this target has Advantage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Deals an additional 1d6 Radiant damage per level.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to make a ranged attack which creates a Piercing damage explosion in addition to dealing normal weapon damage.
itens.descricao: Shoot a volley of thorns. The thorns deal weapon damage to the target and then explode. The explosion deals an additional 1d10 Piercing damage to the target and surrounding creatures. On miss, the thorns still explode. On save, targets still take half damage from the explosion.
itens.ao_resistir: Targets still take half damage from the explosion.
itens.niveis_superiores: When the spell is cast at 2nd Level or higher, the addition AoE damage increases by 1d10 Piercing for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to heal allies that they can see and are within range.
itens.descricao: Healing Heal a creature you can see.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Heals an additional 1d4 Healing for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to surround a creature in hellfire that deals Fire damage as a Reaction when taking damage from them.
itens.descricao: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 2d10 Fire damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Deals an additional 1d10 Fire damage per level.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to instill courage in themselves or an ally; the affected creature cannot be frightened and gains temporary hit points.
itens.descricao: Make yourself or a target immune to Frightened and gain 5 Temporary Hit Points each turn.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to curse a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on a chosen ability check.
itens.descricao: Make your attacks deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target and give it Disadvantage on an Ability of your choosing.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Charisma checks.
itens.descricao: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Constitution checks.
itens.descricao: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Dexterity checks.
itens.descricao: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Intelligence checks.
itens.descricao: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Strength checks.
itens.descricao: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Strength Checks.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to put a curse on a creature and deal additional Necrotic damage to them. The curse also imposes Disadvantage on the creature's Wisdom checks.
itens.descricao: Deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic Necrotic damage when you attack the target and impart Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to mark a creature as their prey and deal additional Weapon damage to the targeted creature.
itens.descricao: Mark a creature as your quarry to deal an additional 1d6 Weapon damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to throw a shard of ice, which explodes and leaves behind an icy surface.
itens.descricao: Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10 Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6 Cold damage to anyone nearby. It leaves an Ice surface. On miss, the shard of ice still explodes.
itens.ao_resistir: The damage from the explosion is negated
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcast: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d6 Cold damage for each Spell Slot Level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows the spellcaster to make a melee attack which inflicts Necrotic damage.
itens.descricao: Putrefy a creature with Necrotic energy filling your hands.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Deals an additional 1d10 Necrotic damage per level.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to make a creature move farther during a turn.
itens.descricao: Increase a creature's Movement Speed by Dist.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affect an additional target for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows a Circle of the Stars druid using Starry Form: Archer to deal radiant damage to a target at a distance.
itens.descricao: Shoot a luminous arrow at a target.
itens.niveis_superiores: At Level 10, Twinkling Constellations increases the base damage to 2d8 Radiant.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to surround an unarmoured creature (including themselves, if unarmoured) with magical protection.
itens.descricao: Surround an unarmoured creature in a protective magical force. Its Armour Class increases to 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with multiple projectiles that deal Force damage.
itens.descricao:
Create three darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target.
The darts always hit their target, and can each be targeted individually.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Creates one additional dart per level also dealing 1d4 + 1 Force.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to surround themselves with magical protection against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead.
itens.descricao: Protect an ally against the attacks and powers of aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with a ray of nauseating energy that deals Poison damage, and potentially Poisons them.
itens.descricao: Possibly Poisoned Poisons the target.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Poison damage for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to ward themselves or an ally against enemy attacks.
itens.descricao: You or an ally cannot be targeted until you attack or harm a creature. You can still take damage from area spells.

itens.resumo: It causes the spellcaster's melee weapon to flare with white-hot intensity, searing their targets on hit.
itens.descricao: Your weapon flares with white-hot intensity. It deals, on top of weapon damage, an extra 1d6 Fire damage and marks the target with Searing Smite.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d6 Fire initial damage for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to avoid being hit by an enemy attack at the last possible instant. It also nullifies Magic Missile damage against them.
itens.descricao: When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile. These effects last until the start of your next turn.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to surround themselves or an ally with divine protection and gain a bonus to their Armour Class.
itens.descricao: Surround a creature with a shimmering field of magic that increases its Armour Class by 2.

itens.resumo: It allows the spellcaster to temporarily make conscious creatures fall into a deep slumber.
itens.descricao: Put creatures into a magical slumber. Select targets up to a combined 24 Hit Points.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affect creatures with more hit points at higher levels. The total hit points of creatures this spell can affect is increased by 8 hit points per level.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to understand and talk to beasts until they long rest.
itens.descricao: Gain the ability to comprehend and communicate with beasts.

itens.resumo: This spell exclusive to the Circle of the Stars druid, allows spellcasters to hit enemies with radiant bolt that deals Radiant damage and grants advantage to attack rolls made against them.
itens.descricao: The next attack roll against this target has Advantage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to send a targeted creature into a fit of laughter, falling Prone.
itens.descricao: Leave a creature Prone with laughter, without the ability to get up.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to cause their melee weapon to ring with Thunder as they strike, pushing targets away and potentially knocking them Prone.
itens.descricao: Your melee weapon rings with thunder as you strike, pushing your target Dist away and possibly knocking them Prone.
itens.ao_resistir: Target takes full damage but isn't knocked Prone

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to project out a deafening force that can hit multiple creatures and objects. Creatures hit by this force may be pushed away from the spellcaster.
itens.descricao: Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects in an area, while also dealing Thunder damage.
itens.ao_resistir: Targets take half damage; aren't pushed away.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage for each spell slot level above 1st.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with a blue ray of electrifying energy that deals Lightning damage to them initially and also on subsequent turns.
itens.descricao: Link yourself to a target with a bolt of lightning. Deal an additional 1d12 Lightning damage each turn by activating it.
itens.niveis_superiores: The initial damage increases by 1d12 Lightning per level; damage on subsequent turns is always 1d12 Lightning.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to channel their wrath through their melee weapon, possibly Frightened Frightening their target on hit.
itens.descricao: Your weapon absorbs your wrath as you strike, possibly Frightened Frightening your target.
itens.ao_resistir: Target takes full damage but isn't frightened

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to heal and embolden their allies and themselves with resolve. Affected creatures have their maximum Hit Points increased for the duration of the spell.
itens.descricao: Bolster your allies with toughness and resolve to heal and increase their Hit Points maximum.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level increases the target's maximum health by an additional 5 Healing for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to magically lock a container.
itens.descricao: Close a door or container with a magical lock. It can no longer be lockpicked or opened with Knock.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to fortify the defense of a willing creature and increase their Armour Class. While under the effect of this spell, the target's skin has a bark-like texture.
itens.descricao: Touch a willing creature to toughen its skin and increase its Armour Class up to 16.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bestow upon a creature the fortitude of a bear. Affected creatures gain Temporary Hit Points and Advantage on Constitution Checks.
itens.descricao: Creature gains Advantage on Constitution Checks and gains 7 Temporary Hit Points.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to magically Blindness Blind a targeted hostile creature.
itens.descricao: Blindness Blind a creature. Attack Rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It blurs the spellcaster's body, making them harder to hit.
itens.descricao: Attackers have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.

itens.resumo: It causes a spellcaster's weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allowing them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible.
itens.descricao: Your weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible.
itens.niveis_superiores: Deals an additional 1d6 Radiant damage per level.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Branding Smite. It allows spellcasters to cause their melee weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allow them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible
itens.descricao: Your melee weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible.
itens.niveis_superiores: Deals an additional 1d6 Radiant damage per level.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Branding Smite. It allows spellcasters to cause their ranged weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allow them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible
itens.descricao: Your ranged weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible.
itens.niveis_superiores: Deals an additional 1d6 Radiant damage per level.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bestow upon a creature the might of a bull. Recipients double their Carrying Capacity and gain Advantage on Strength Checks.
itens.descricao: Creature gains Advantage on Strength Checks and its Weight Limit is doubled.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to magically subdue intense emotions in targeted creatures. The affected target becomes neutral to the creatures it was hostile toward. It also cannot be Charmed or Frightened during the duration of the spell.
itens.descricao: Humanoids can't be Charmed, Frightened, or become enraged.see bugs

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bestow upon a creature the finesse of a cat. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Dexterity Checks and Resistance to falling damage.
itens.descricao: Creature gains Advantage on Dexterity Checks and only takes half damage from falling.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to conjure a barrage of daggers in an area which deals Slashing damage to any creature entering or starting its turn in the area.
itens.descricao: Conjure a cloud of spinning daggers that attack anyone inside.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 2d4 Slashing damage for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a humanoid creature and induce madness in their mind. The affected creature then makes a melee attack against any creature aside from the caster within its reach.
itens.descricao:
Instil madness in a humanoid enemy, making them attack the creature closest to them (other than you), even if it's allied.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a WIS to end this condition.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to conjure a cloud of darkness in an area within range which obscures and inflicts Blinded Blindness to those within it.
itens.descricao: Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscured Heavily Obscures and inflicts Blinded Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to alter a creature's sight, granting them the ability to see in the dark.
itens.descricao: Grant a creature the ability to see in the dark out to a range of {dist.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to telepathically link to unprotected minds and hear the thoughts of targeted creatures while talking to them.
itens.descricao: Focus your mind to read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bestow upon a creature the elegance of an eagle. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Charisma Checks.
itens.descricao: Creature gains Advantage on Charisma Checks.
itens.niveis_superiores: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to strengthen an aspect of a creature's physical or mental attributes.
itens.descricao: Bestow a magical enchantment upon an ally. They gain Advantage on Ability Checks with a chosen Ability.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to increase a creature's body size. Affected creatures deal more damage with their weapons and gain Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao:
Make a creature larger.
Its weapons deal an extra d4 Physical 1d4 damage. It has Advantage on Strength Checks and SavingThrows.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to alter a creature's body size. The caster can choose to double or halve the size of the affected creature.
itens.descricao:
Make a creature larger or smaller. Either option has a duration of 10 turns.
This affects their weapon damage and Strength Checks and SavingThrows.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to capture the attention of a creature, forcing it to focus on them.
itens.descricao: Reduce a creature's peripheral vision and make it look at you.

itens.resumo: It creates a dark cloud that heavily obscures and blinds all creatures inside, while the caster also gains a condition to see in this darkness for the spell's duration.
itens.descricao: Create a dark shroud that Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a fiery scimitar in their free hand that sheds bright light. Casters can make a melee weapon attack with the blade to deal Fire damage to enemies.
itens.descricao: Conjure a flaming Flame Blade (weapon) in your hand for 10 turns that deals 3d6 Fire damage. It sheds a bright light in a Dist radius and a dim light in a Dist radius.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Damage increases by 1d6 Fire for every two spell slot levels above 2nd (e.g., a total of 4d6 at levels 4 and 5, and 5d6 at level 6).

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to conjure a Flaming Sphere which can attack and burn enemies.
itens.descricao: Summon a Flaming Sphere that deals 2d6 Fire damage to nearby enemies and objects. It also sheds bright light in a Dist radius, and dim light for an additional Dist. You can move the sphere.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d6 Fire damage for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bestow upon a creature the slyness of a fox. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Intelligence Checks.
itens.descricao: Creature gains Advantage on Intelligence Checks.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to conjure a squall to clear dangerous gasses or throw creatures back, potentially causing a dangerous fall.
itens.descricao: Summon a strong wind that clears all clouds. Any creatures caught in the gale who fail a Strength SavingThrow will be pushed back dist and be thrown Off Balance.
itens.ao_resistir: Targets aren't pushed back or put off balance.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to heat up a metal weapon or armour on the targeted creature, forcing them to let go or receive damage or suffer various penalties.
itens.descricao: Cause a metal weapon or armour to glow red-hot and force the wearer to let go or receive Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
itens.ao_resistir: Target takes full damage, but suffers Disadvantage on attack rolls instead of being disarmed
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Fire damage for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to hold a target humanoid in place. The affected creature is unable to move or act and is more susceptible to attacks.
itens.descricao:
Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within dist are always Critical Hits.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a WIS to end this condition.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to turn themselves and other creatures Invisible to the naked eye.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to turn it Invisible. Attacks against it have Disadvantage. It attacks with Advantage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to unlock non-magical locks.
itens.descricao: Unlock an object that is held shut by a mundane lock.

itens.resumo: It allows the spellcaster to cure an adjacent creature.
itens.descricao: Cure a creature from diseased, poisoned, Paralysed Paralysis, or blinded.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to infuse a weapon with arcane energy, making it magical.
itens.descricao: Infuse a weapon with arcane energy. The weapon becomes magical, receiving a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The bonus increases by 1 for every two spell slot levels above 2nd (e.g., +2 at levels 4 and 5, and +3 at level 6).

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to shoot a magical arrow that deals Acid Acid damage to a target on impact and at the end of its next turn.
itens.descricao:
Shoot a green arrow that bursts in a spray of acid. Deals 4d4 Acid damage immediately and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.
If the spell misses, the target still takes half the initial damage, but no damage at the end of its next turn.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 2d4 Acid damage (1d4 Acid on impact and at the end of target's turn) for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to create 3 illusory duplicates of themselves to distract attackers.
itens.descricao: Create 3 illusory duplicates of yourself to distract attackers. Each duplicate increases your Armour Class by 3.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to teleport themselves to an unoccupied space they can see.
itens.descricao: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to call down a beam of moonlight which deals Radiant damage to any creature that enters the beam or starts its turn there.
itens.descricao: Call down a beam of light that damages any creatures that enters the beam or starts its turn in the light. You can use an Action to move the beam Dist.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When the spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, damage increases by 1d10 Radiant for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bestow upon a creature the intuition of an owl. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Wisdom Checks.
itens.descricao: Creature gains Advantage on Wisdom Checks.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to grant themselves and nearby allies a bonus to Stealth Checks.
itens.descricao: Call forth a veil of shadow and silence that gives you and nearby allies a +10 bonus to Stealths.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to flood a target creature's mind with an illusion of the last thing that attacked it, dealing 1d6 Psychic damage per turn, changing to the last type of damage inflicted upon the target.
itens.descricao: Deal damage to a creature each turn. At the start of its turn, it takes Psychic Psychic damage. Each subsequent time it takes damage, the damage type of Phantasmal Force changes to match that damage type.

itens.resumo: It allows clerics to heal all allies outside of combat.
itens.descricao: Healing Heal all allies you can see within range.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When the spell is cast at 3rd Level or higher, heal a target an extra 1d8 Healing for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to grant the creature they touch protection from Poison and poisonous effects.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to neutralise all poisons affecting it, and grant it protection against poisonous influences.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to make a ranged spell attack against a creature and sap their Strength. A weakened creature deals half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength.
itens.descricao: Weaken a foe: they deal half damage with weapon attacks using Strength.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to decrease a creature's body size. Affected creatures deal less damage with their weapons and have Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao:
Make a creature smaller.
Its weapons deal d4 Physical 1d4 less damage (minimum of 1 damage). It has Disadvantage on Strength Checks and SavingThrows.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to hurl 3 rays of fire at one or more targets within range. Each ray has a separate Attack Roll and deals Fire damage.
itens.descricao: Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level hurls an additional ray for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to see Invisible objects and creatures within range while not Incapacitated. Creatures within range which fail a Dexterity Saving Throw lose their Invisible invisibility.
itens.descricao: Become able to see Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others.

itens.resumo: It creates a Shadow Blade in the caster's main hand which deals Psychic damage.
itens.descricao: Weave a shadowy shortsword in your hand that deals 2d8 Psychic damage.
itens.niveis_superiores:
Upcasting: When you cast this spell using a 3rd or 4th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 3d8 Psychic.
Upcasting: When you cast this spell using a 5th or 6th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 4d8 Psychic.

itens.resumo: It allows the spellcaster to generate a deafening noise explosion that can damage multiple creatures and objects. This spell is especially potent against inorganic targets, which must make their Saving Throw at Disadvantage.
itens.descricao: Damages all nearby creatures and objects.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage for each spell slot level above 2nd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a sphere of absolute quiet in an area within range. Creatures within this sphere are immune to Thunder damage and cannot cast verbal spells.
itens.descricao: Create a sound-proof sphere. All within are Silenced and Immune to Thunder damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to transform an area of land into a hazardous spiky terrain. Creatures walking through the area have their speed halved and take Piercing damage.
itens.descricao:
Shape a piece of ground into hard spikes. A creature walking on the spikes takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every Dist it moves.
The spikes are Difficult Terrain, halving a creature's Movement Speed.

itens.resumo: It summons a floating weapon that can attack enemies. The caster can choose between several different weapons, and each has a different weapon action.
itens.descricao: Summon a floating, spectral weapon that attacks your enemies alongside you.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Greataxe that can attack enemies.
itens.descricao: Create a floating, spectral greataxe.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 2 Evocation Spell, Spiritual Weapon. It allows spellcasters to summon a floating Greatsword that can attack enemies.
itens.descricao: Create a floating, spectral greatsword.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

itens.descricao: Create a floating, spectral halberd.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

itens.descricao: Create a floating, spectral maul.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

itens.descricao: Create a floating, spectral spear.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.
