itens.descricao: Create a floating, spectral trident.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bolster an ally's defenses while also sharing any damage they receive.
itens.descricao: Ward an ally. They gain resistance to all damage, and a +1 bonus to their ArmourClass and SavingThrows.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to conjure a mass of sticky and flammable web at an area within range. Creatures moving or entering this area have their speed halved and can become caught in the web.
itens.descricao:
Cover an area in thick, flammable webbing that can Enwebbed Enweb creatures within.
An ally can use its Help action to try and tear away the webs.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create an undead servant.
itens.descricao: Animate a corpse to create an undead servant while not in combat.
itens.niveis_superiores:
When the spell is cast at 4th Level, raise up to 3 Skeletons or Zombies instead of 1.
When the spell is cast at 5th Level, raise a Ghoul or Flying Ghoul.
When the spell is cast at 6th Level, raise up to 3 Ghouls or Flying Ghouls instead of 1.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Skeleton_(Animate Dead) Skeleton that focuses on ranged weaponry. They must target a corpse, and the skeleton lasts until killed or until the next long rest.
itens.descricao: Create a skeleton that specialises in ranged combat.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Zombie (Animate Dead) Zombie that specializes in melee combat. They must target a corpse, and the zombie lasts until killed or the next long rest.
itens.descricao: Create a zombie that specialises in melee combat.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to bolster their allies with hope and vitality.
itens.descricao: Your allies will regain the maximum Hit Points possible when healed. They also gain Advantage on Wisdom SavingThrows and Death Saving Throws.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to curse a target with their touch.
itens.descricao:
Curse a creature with your touch. The curse either bestows Disadvantage on Ability Checks and SavingThrows, Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, lets you deal additional damage to the target, or robs it of its Actions.
The effect of the curse is based on the variant selected and lasts for 10 turns.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to take additional damage from the caster's attacks and spells.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. Your attacks and spells deal an additional 1d8 Necrotic damage to the target.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing their attacks against the caster to have Disadvantage.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Charisma Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Charisma Ability Checks and SavingThrows.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Constitution Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Constitution Ability Checks and SavingThrows.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Dexterity Ability Checks and SavingThrows.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target with dread, causing them to possibly skip their turn.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It fills with dread, possibly skipping its turn.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Intelligence Ability Checks and SavingThrows.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Strength Ability Checks and SavingThrows.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to curse a target, causing it to suffer Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and Saving Throws.
itens.descricao: Curse a creature with your touch. It suffers Disadvantage on Wisdom Ability Checks and SavingThrows.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The duration is increased to 20 turns when cast at level 4, to 50 turns at level 5, and to 100 turns at level 6.

itens.resumo: It allows a Paladin to expend a Spell Slot to deal additional Radiant damage with a melee weapon attack and possibly blind their target.
itens.descricao: Evoke a heavenly flare and possibly Blinded (Blinding Smite) Blind your target
itens.ao_resistir: Target takes full damage but isn't blinded

itens.resumo: It allows the spellcaster to travel to the Ethereal Plane, unassailable and unseen until they return.
itens.descricao: At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you vanish into the Ethereal Plane. While there, you can't be harmed or seen in this world.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to call down lightning to hit all targets within the area of effect. The spellcaster can also call down lightning repeatedly on subsequent turns.
itens.descricao: Lightning strikes all targets within the area of effect for 3d10 Lightning damage. Then for 10 turns, you can call down lightning again without expending a spell slot.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: When the spell is cast using a 4th-level spell slot or higher, it deals an additional 1d10 Lightning damage for each spell slot level above 3rd for the initial casting and all granted free casts.

itens.resumo: It allows rangers to use one of their weapons to strike everyone within a wide cone with a barrage of magical blades.
itens.descricao: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.
itens.niveis_superiores: Cannot be upcast.see bugs

itens.resumo: This spell allows rangers to use their melee weapon to strike everyone within a wide cone with a barrage of magical blades. This spell is a variant of Conjure Barrage.
itens.descricao: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.
itens.niveis_superiores: Cannot be upcast.see bugs

itens.resumo: This spell allows rangers to use their ranged weapon to strike everyone within a wide cone with a barrage of magical blades. This spell is a variant of Conjure Barrage.
itens.descricao: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.
itens.niveis_superiores: Cannot be upcast.see bugs

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to interrupt another caster's spellcasting, causing it to fail and have no effect.
itens.descricao: Try to stop a spell being cast.
itens.niveis_superiores: Counterspell can be upcast to counter spells of higher levels without requiring a check.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to imbue their allies' weapons with holy power, causing them to deal additional Radiant damage.
itens.descricao: Radiate a holy power that emboldens you and nearby allies. Their weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to dispel darkness by summoning a sphere of light or enchanting an item to shine like the sun.
itens.descricao: Enchant an item to shine like the sun or summon a sphere of sunlight that dispels all darkness around it.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the spell Daylight. This variant of the spell allows spellcasters to enchant an item to shine like the sun.
itens.descricao: Enchant an item or weapon to shine with the light of the sun and dispel all darkness around it. Target must have a weapon in its main hand.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the spell Daylight This variant allows spellcasters to dispel darkness by summoning a sphere of light.
itens.descricao: Summon a sphere of sunlight that dispels all darkness around it. The sphere cannot be moved.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to dispel magic cast upon a character or object.
itens.descricao: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any Level 3 spell or lower on the target ends. For each Level 4 spell or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.-->
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcast: You automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.-->

itens.resumo: It imbues a weapon with a chosen energy type, increasing its damage and accuracy.
itens.descricao: Imbue a weapon with elemental power. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 damage of your choice.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell using a 5th or 6th level Spell Slot increases the Attack Rolls bonus by 1 and additional 1d4 damage of your choice.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with corrosive might, granting it bonus Acid Acid damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.
itens.descricao: Imbue a weapon with corrosive might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Acid damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell using a 5th or 6th level Spell Slot would increase the Attack Rolls bonus by 1 and additional 1d4 Acid damage.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with icy might, granting it bonus Cold Cold damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.
itens.descricao: Imbue a weapon with an icy might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Cold damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell using a 5th or 6th level Spell Slot would increase the Attack Rolls bonus by 1 and additional 1d4 Cold damage.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with fiery might, granting it bonus Fire Fire damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.
itens.descricao: Imbue a weapon with fiery might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Fire damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell using a 5th or 6th level Spell Slot would increase the Attack Rolls bonus by 1 and additional 1d4 Fire damage.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with electrical might, granting it bonus Lightning Lightning damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.
itens.descricao: Imbue a weapon with an electrical might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Lightning damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell using a 5th or 6th level Spell Slot would increase the Attack Rolls bonus by 1 and additional 1d4 Lightning damage.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Elemental Weapon and imbues a weapon with thunderous might, granting it bonus Thunder Thunder damage and a +1 bonus to attack rolls.
itens.descricao: Imbue a weapon with thunderous might. It receives a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4 Thunder damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell using a 5th or 6th level Spell Slot would increase the Attack Rolls bonus by 1 and additional 1d4 Thunder damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to terrify targets by projecting phantasmal images, forcing enemies to flee.
itens.descricao: Hostile targets drop everything and become Fearful: they have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to put their allies into a magical, protective coma, feigning death.
itens.descricao: Put an ally in a protective coma. They become Resistant to all damage except Psychic. Disease and poison no longer have any effect.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to unleash a streak of fire from their hands which ignites into a large explosion at a chosen point within range.
itens.descricao: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for 8d6 Fire damage.
itens.niveis_superiores: When the spell is cast using a 4th level slot or higher, damage increases by 1d6 Fire for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to transform themselves or an ally into a cloud of mist to avoid attacks, reduce size, and gain Advantage on some Saving Throws.
itens.descricao: Transform yourself or an ally into a tiny gas cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward that can trigger various magical effects when stepped on by an enemy.
itens.descricao: Inscribe a circle of arcane glyphs on the ground. When stepped on by an enemy the selected magical effect will trigger.
itens.ao_resistir: Targets still take half damage; for sleep and detonation variants, nothing happens
itens.niveis_superiores: See each individual variant's page.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Acid damage to enemies when triggered.
itens.descricao:
The glyph explodes, dealing Acid damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity still take half damage. 
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Acid damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Cold damage to enemies when triggered.
itens.descricao:
The glyph explodes, dealing Cold damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity still take half damage. 
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Cold damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and pushes every creature back when triggered.
itens.descricao:
The glyph emits a gust of wind that pushes back everyone within range when stepped on by an enemy. Any creatures within the area of effect that fail the Dexterity will be pushed back.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Fire damage to enemies when triggered.
itens.descricao:
The glyph explodes, dealing Fire damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity still take half damage. 
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Fire damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. This variant of the spell allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward that explodes and deals Lightning damage to enemies when triggered.
itens.descricao:
The glyph explodes, dealing Lightning damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity still take half damage. 
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Lightning damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which can put enemies to Sleeping Sleep when triggered.
itens.descricao:
The glyph emits a soothing magic that puts everyone within range to Sleeping Sleep when stepped on by an enemy. Any creatures within the area of effect (that aren't immune to magical sleep) that fail the Dexterity will be put to Sleep.
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 3 Abjuration Spell, Glyph of Warding. It allows spellcasters to inscribe a ward which explodes and deals Thunder damage to enemies when triggered.
itens.descricao:
The glyph explodes, dealing Thunder damage to enemies in the vicinity. Creatures who pass the Dexterity still take half damage. 
The glyph will last until triggered, or until a Long Rest.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch the ability to fly.
itens.descricao: Bestow the ability to Flight Fly upon yourself or an ally.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to allow their allies to become Hastened.
itens.descricao: Target yourself or an ally to become Hastened. The creature has a +2 bonus to Armour Class, Advantage on Dexterity SavingThrows, its Movement Speed is doubled, and can take one additional Action per turn.

itens.resumo: It creates an area that deals damage and inflicts conditions to creatures in it, including reduced movement speed.
itens.descricao: Creatures within this black sphere are Blinded and take damage at the end of their turn and the start of their turn.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to hypnotise all creatures within an area.
itens.descricao: Hypnotised Hypnotise creatures that can see the pattern. They cannot attack you. They cannot move nor act.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to fire an arrow of electricity that bursts on impact, dealing additional Lightning Lightning damage to creatures in the vicinity.
itens.descricao: After the arrow hits, smaller bolts snake out from the target towards nearby creatures.
itens.ao_resistir: Targets still take half damage from the area of effect.
itens.niveis_superiores: When the spell is cast at 4th level or higher, both the primary arrow damage and the burst damage increase by 1d8 Lightning for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to discharge a bolt of lightning in any direction, potentially hitting multiple creatures.
itens.descricao: Call forth a blast of lightning that hits all creatures in the line of the eruption.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d6 Lightning for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to heal several allies that they can see within range.
itens.descricao: Heal your nearby allies.
itens.niveis_superiores: When this spell is cast using a 4th level slot or higher, targets heal an extra 1d4 Healing for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to cause an area to expel weeds from the ground, quartering the movement speed of all creatures travelling through the area.
itens.descricao: Make weeds burst from the ground and smother the area. Creatures moving through the weeds have their Movement Speed quartered.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to an element of their choice.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Acid damage.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Acid damage.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Cold damage.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Cold damage.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Fire damage.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Fire damage.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Lightning damage.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Lightning damage.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to grant a creature they touch Resistance to Thunder damage.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature to grant it Resistance to Thunder damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to remove all curses afflicting a target by touch.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature or object to remove all Curses and Hexes affecting it.

itens.resumo: It allows the spellcaster to bring a Companion with 0 hit points back to life.
itens.descricao: Revive a companion. They return to life with 1 hit point.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to call forth a storm that douses fire, creates an icy surface, and disrupts the concentration of spellcasters.
itens.descricao:
Call forth a storm that douses fire, creates an Ice surface, and forces spellcasters to succeed at a Concentration SavingThrow in order to maintain Concentration.
Ice is a surface that is considered Difficult Terrain. Creatures moving through it have their Movement Speed halved, and will fall Prone on a failed Dexterity SavingThrow.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to reduce movement speed, Armour Class, and Dexterity Saving Throws, and also limit actions.
itens.descricao: Alter time around up to 6 enemies to Slow them. They won't get far, they can't do much, and they're easier to hit.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions.
itens.descricao: Grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to call forth spirits to damage nearby targets and slow their Movement.
itens.descricao: Call forth spirits to protect you.
itens.niveis_superiores: When the spell is cast using a 4th Level spell slot or higher, damage increases by 1d8 Radiant or 1d8 Necrotic damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the spell Spirit Guardians. This variant deals Necrotic damage as well as slows the Movement of nearby enemies.
itens.descricao: Call forth spirits to protect the area around you.
itens.niveis_superiores: When the spell is cast using a 4th Level spell slot or higher, damage increases by 1d8 Necrotic damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the spell Spirit Guardians. This variant deals Radiant damage as well as slows the Movement of nearby enemies.
itens.descricao: Call forth spirits to protect the area around you.
itens.niveis_superiores: When the spell is cast using a 4th Level spell slot or higher, damage increases by 1d8 Radiant damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to create a nauseating cloud of gas which can prevent creatures from taking actions. Targets must make Constitution SavingThrows every turn while they are in the area of effect or become Nauseous.
itens.descricao: Create a cloud of gas so nauseating it prevents creatures from taking actions.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters at melee range to siphon the life force of their target.
itens.descricao: Touch an enemy to siphon their life force and regain half as many Hit Points.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage for each spell slot level above 3rd.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to heal allies repeatedly with Restore Vitality using only bonus actions for 10 turns.
itens.descricao: While this aura lasts, you can cast Restore Vitality as a bonus to heal yourself or nearby allies by 2d6 Healing.

itens.resumo: This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Skeleton that can summon 3 Skeletons instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.
itens.descricao: Create 3 Skeletons that specialise in ranged combat.

itens.resumo: This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Zombie that can summon 3 Zombie (Animate Dead) Zombies instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.
itens.descricao: Create 3 zombies that specialise in melee combat.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to temporarily send a target to another plane of existence.
itens.descricao: Temporarily Banished Banish your target to another plane of existence.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affect an additional target per level.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to drain the moisture and vitality from a target creature using necromantic energy. It is especially effective versus plants.
itens.descricao: Deals 8d8 Necrotic damage to a target. Plants take maximum damage from this spell, and have Disadvantage on the SavingThrow against it.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage for each spell slot level above 4th.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to confuse a group of creatures, drastically reducing their effectiveness in combat.
itens.descricao: Confused Confuse a group of creatures, causing them to attack at random, wander around aimlessly, and occasionally skip turns in the stupor.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Increases the radius of the affected area by dist per additional spell slot level.

itens.resumo: It conjures 2 Mud Mephits, 2 Ice Mephits, or an Azer to fight for you.
itens.descricao: Conjure a minor elemental to fight alongside you.

itens.resumo: It is a variant of Conjure Minor Elemental that summons an Azer.
itens.descricao: Conjure an azer from the Plane of Fire. It deals both Bludgeoning and Fire damage with its warhammer, and can Overheat. It carries the Azer Warhammer.

itens.resumo: It is a variant of Conjure Minor Elemental that summons two Ice Mephits.
itens.descricao: Conjure two ice mephits from the Elemental Chaos. They can Chromatic Orb: Cold Hurl and Ice Breath Exhale ice, and Death Burst (Cold) Explode when they die.

itens.resumo: It is a variant of Conjure Minor Elemental that summons two Mud Mephits.
itens.descricao: Conjure two mud mephits from the Elemental Chaos. They can cast Mud Breath and Death Burst (Mud) Explode when they die.

itens.resumo: It summons a Dryad to fight alongside the caster.
itens.descricao: Conjure a dryad to fight alongside you. She can use Nature's Step, Entangle enemies, and Fallen Lover Summon a wood woad.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to prevent a target from dying.
itens.descricao: Protect a creature from death. The next time damage would reduce it to 0 Hit Points, it remains conscious with 1 Hit Point left.

itens.resumo: It teleports the caster and an ally.
itens.descricao: Teleport yourself and up to one adjacent ally to a place you can see. The ally cannot be larger than Medium.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a Beast into fighting alongside the caster, rather than against them.
itens.descricao: Make a beast fight alongside you. Every time the Beast takes damage, it makes a Wisdom SavingThrow against your domination.

itens.resumo: It summons tentacles in an area that make it difficult to move and harm creatures.
itens.descricao: Tentacles sprout from the ground, turning the area into Difficult Terrain , attacking and Black Tentacles Smothering creatures within.

itens.resumo: It shields the spellcaster with luminous energy.
itens.descricao: Wreathe your body in flames that shed light in a dist radius, provide Resistance to Fire or Cold damage, and retaliate against melee attacks.

itens.resumo: This spell shields the spellcaster with ice-cold flames. It is a variant of Fire Shield.
itens.descricao: Ice-cold flames shed light in a dist radius. You take only half the damage of all Fire damage, and deal 2d8 Cold damage to anyone who hits you with a melee attack.

itens.resumo: This spell shields the spellcaster with scorching flames. It is a variant of Fire Shield
itens.descricao: Scorching flames shed light in a dist radius. You take only half the damage of all Cold damage, and deal 2d8 Fire damage to anyone who hits you with a melee attack.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to imbue an ally with the ability to avoid some slowing effects.
itens.descricao: Snap an ally out of any Stunned Stun. Difficult Terrain can't slow them down, and they can't be magically Paralysed or Restrained.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a Grasping Vine which can pull enemies toward itself.
itens.descricao: Summon a giant vine capable of dragging creatures toward itself.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to provide a more resilient form of Invisibility for their allies.
itens.descricao: Turn a creature Invisible. Attacks against it have Disadvantage. It attacks with Advantage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a divine guardian which sacrifices its Hit Points to damage enemies.
itens.descricao: Call forth a divine guardian that attacks nearby enemies. Every time it deals damage, the guardian loses an equal amount of Hit Points.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon an ice storm to strike an area.
itens.descricao: Impel a storm of hail and ice to crash from the sky, covering the ground and striking all objects and creatures within range, dealing Bludgeoning and Cold damage. It also creates an Ice surface that lasts 2 turns.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Bludgeoning damage for each spell slot level above 4th.

itens.resumo: It surrounds a target in an impenetrable protective sphere which blocks everything from coming in or out of the sphere. The encased creature is rendered completely invulnerable to outside attacks or spells, but conversely is blocked from attacking or targeting anything outside the sphere.
itens.descricao: Enclose a target in a sphere of shimmering force, reducing its movement speed by half, and blocking all incoming and spell effects.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to temporarily haunt a creatures mind with illusions, dealing damage, preventing movement, and imposing Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.
itens.descricao: Haunt a creature with illusions of its greatest fears. It takes 4d10 Psychic damage per turn, cannot move, has Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcast: When this spell is cast at 5th level or higher, it deals an additional 1d10 Psychic damage per level per turn.

itens.resumo: It transforms a creature into a sheep.
itens.descricao: Transform a creature into a harmless sheep.

itens.resumo: It adds Psychic damage to the spellcaster's weapon as they strike, possibly staggering the target when hit.
itens.descricao: Possibly Staggering Smite Stagger your target. It can't take reactions and is more likely to miss.
itens.ao_resistir: Target takes full damage but isn't staggered

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to harden the skin of their ally, granting them Resistance to non-magical physical damage.
itens.descricao: Turn a creature's flesh hard as stone. It takes only half the damage of all non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to create a long, fiery barrier, damaging anything in the area.
itens.descricao: Create a blazing wall of fire, Burning anyone who dares stand too close. Deals Fire to anything that moves into or ends its turn in the area.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Fire damage for each spell slot level above 4th.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Flying Ghoul. Requires a corpse, and lasts until long rest.
itens.descricao: Create a Flying Ghoul that specialises in melee combat.

itens.resumo: This spell allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create a Ghoul (Animate Dead) Ghoul (Animate Dead). Requires a corpse, and lasts until long rest.
itens.descricao: Create a ghoul that specializes in melee combat.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to imbue their weapon with power, dealing force damage and possibly Banished Banishing the target.
itens.descricao: Possibly Banished Banish your target to another plane of existence.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to imbue their weapon with power, dealing force damage and possibly Banished Banishing the target.
itens.descricao: Possibly Banished Banish your target to another plane of existence.

itens.resumo: This spells allows spellcasters to imbue their weapon with power, dealing force damage and possibly Banished Banishing the target.
itens.descricao: Possibly Banished Banish your target to another plane of existence.

itens.resumo: It conjures a moveable cloud which damages and obscures everything it envelops.
itens.descricao: Craft a large cloud that inflicts 5d8 Poison damage per turn. You can reposition the cloud every turn.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 Poison damage for each spell slot level above 5th.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to blast icy air into a region in front of them, damaging affected creatures and turning existing Water Water surfaces into Ice Ice Surfaces.
itens.descricao: Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: The damage is increased by 1d8 Cold for each spell slot level above 5th.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a Fire, Earth, Water, or Air Elemental.
itens.descricao: Bend the barrier between the Planes until they disgorge an elemental ally to follow and fight for you.
itens.niveis_superiores: At level 6, the spellcaster can summon an Air Myrmidon, Earth Myrmidon, Fire Myrmidon, or Water Myrmidon.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon an Air Elemental.
itens.descricao: The air elemental can use Primordial Gales, Gushing Air, and can Shocked Shock your foes.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon an Earth Elemental.
itens.descricao: The earth elemental can use Seismic Strike, Soil-Clogged Slam, and can create sludgy mud surfaces while walloping your foes.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon a Fire Elemental.
itens.descricao: The fire elemental can use Smouldering Touch, Erupting Cinder, and can make your foes Burning Burn.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon a Water Elemental.
itens.descricao: The water elemental can use Winter's Breath, Slam (Water Elemental) Slam, and can mete out cold punishment upon foes with its fists.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to infect their target with an affliction of their choosing, potentially resulting in the target contracting a disease.
itens.descricao:
Poison a target and possibly afflict them with a disease of your choice.
Once infected, the target will roll a Constitution SavingThrow each turn. If it accumulates 3 successes, it recovers. If it accumulates 3 failures, it contracts the disease chosen by the spellcaster.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the Level 5 Necromancy Spell, Contagion. It allows spellcasters to Poison an enemy, with the possibility of the affliction progressing into a Disease which saps target's Wisdom.
itens.descricao: The target receives Disadvantage on Wisdom Ability Checks and Saving Throws, and is Blinded.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the Level 5 Necromancy Spell, Contagion. It allows spellcasters to Poison an enemy, with the possibility of the affliction progressing into a Disease which saps target's Strength.
itens.descricao: The target receives Disadvantage on Strength Ability Checks, Saving Throws, and Attack Rolls that use Strength.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the Level 5 Necromancy Spell, Contagion. It allows spellcasters to Poison an enemy, with the possibility of the affliction progressing into a Disease which saps target's Charisma.
itens.descricao: The target receives Disadvantage on Charisma Ability Checks, and is afflicted with Vulnerability to all damage.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the Level 5 Necromancy Spell, Contagion. It allows spellcasters to Poison an enemy, with the possibility of the affliction progressing into a Disease which saps target's Intelligence.
itens.descricao: The target receives Disadvantage on Intelligence Ability Checks and Saving Throws, and is Befuddled (Timmask Spores).

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the Level 5 Necromancy Spell, Contagion. It allows spellcasters to Poison an enemy, with the possibility of the affliction progressing into a Disease which saps target's Dexterity.
itens.descricao: The target receives Disadvantage on Dexterity Ability Checks, Saving Throws, and Attack Rolls.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variation of the Level 5 Necromancy Spell, Contagion. It allows spellcasters to Poison an enemy, with the possibility of the affliction progressing into a Disease which saps target's Constitution.
itens.descricao: The target receives Disadvantage on Constitution Ability Checks and Saving Throws. Whenever they are hit, they get Stunned.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to create a massive shockwave that damages enemies and can possibly knock them prone.
itens.descricao: Create a shockwave of either divine or malevolent thunder that damages nearby enemies and possibly knocks them Prone.

itens.resumo: This spell allows the caster to create a massive shockwave that damages enemies and can possibly knock them prone.
itens.descricao: Emit a shockwave of malevolent thunder that damages nearby enemies and possibly knocks them Prone.

itens.resumo: This spell allows the caster to create a massive shockwave that damages enemies and can possibly knock them prone.
itens.descricao: Emit a shockwave of divine thunder that damages nearby enemies and possibly knocks them Prone.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to protect themselves from Evil and Good creatures, and allows them to break Enchantments on allies.
itens.descricao: Aberrationssee bugs, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to force a humanoid to temporarily fight as an ally.
itens.descricao: Dominated Dominate a nearby humanoid. Allies are unaffected.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to make a pillar of divine flame at a chosen location dealing 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage.
itens.descricao: Make a pillar of divine fire roar down from the heavens like the wrath of affronted angels.
itens.niveis_superiores: Deals an additional 1d6 Fire damage and 1d6 Radiant damage for each spell slot level above 5th.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to removes any kind of charm, petrification, stun, or curse effect from a creature.
itens.descricao: Touch a creature and negate any Charm, Petrification, Stun, or Curse.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to Paralyse a creature, preventing them from acting and making them vulnerable to attacks.
itens.descricao: Hold Monster Paralyse a creature. It can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within dist are always critical hits.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 5th.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to create a damaging, debilitating swarm of insects over a section of the battlefield.
itens.descricao: Locusts attack everyone within range, make the area Difficult Terrain, and impose Disadvantage on Perception Checks.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d10 Piercing damage for each spell slot level above 5th.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to heal several of their allies.
itens.descricao: Unleash a soothing hum of energy that heals you and nearby allies.
itens.niveis_superiores: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level heals an extra 1d8 Healing for each spell slot level above 5th.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to take control of a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend.
itens.descricao: Target an otherworldly creature and attach its consciousness to your own. It will follow and fight for you as an ally.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to disguise their allies.
itens.descricao: Disguise up to 4 members of your adventuring party.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to throw creatures and objects around with only their mind.
itens.descricao: Throw a creature or object up to Dist with a thought. Once per turn, you can use Telekinesis again without expending a Spell Slot.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to create a solid stone barrier.
itens.descricao:
Raise a wall of non-magical, solid stone.
The wall can be created between any two points within range as long as there is a clear path between them. It is made up of Stone Pillars with 30 HP each, immune to Psychic and vulnerable to Force and Thunder damage. Pillars block movement and line of sight.

itens.resumo: This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul that can summon 3 Flying Ghouls instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.
itens.descricao: Create 3 Flying Ghouls that specialise in melee combat.

itens.resumo: This spell is a higher level version of Animate Dead: Ghoul that can summon 3 Ghoul (Animate Dead) Ghouls instead of 1. Accordingly, the user must also target 3 corpses for this instead of 1.
itens.descricao: Create 3 Ghouls that specialise in melee combat.

itens.resumo: It creates two connected portals which allow creatures to freely teleport between them.
itens.descricao: Create two linked teleportation portals within range. All creatures, including enemies, may travel between the two portals as a free action.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a wall of cutting blades.
itens.descricao: Summons a wall of razor-sharp blades that turns the area into Difficult Terrain and damages anyone foolish enough to come close.

itens.resumo: It allows casters to create a bolt of lightning which strikes a target and chains to nearby enemies.
itens.descricao: Strike an enemy with lightning. Three more bolts will leap from the target, electrifying as many as three other enemies within range.

itens.resumo: It devastates all creatures within a large radius with Necrotic energy.
itens.descricao: Sculpt a massive sphere of entropic energy around a creature. Devastate the target and all surrounding creatures.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon an Air Myrmidon.
itens.descricao: The myrmidon can cast Invisibility (Air Myrmidon) Invisibility, Electrified Flail, and Raging Vortex.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon an Earth Myrmidon.
itens.descricao: The myrmidon can cast Muck to Metal, Sludgy Sling, and Burrow (Earth Myrmidon).

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon a Fire Myrmidon.
itens.descricao: The myrmidon can cast Scorching Strike, Myrmidon's Immolation, and Cinderous Swipe.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of Conjure Elemental that allows spellcasters to summon a Water Myrmidon.
itens.descricao: The myrmidon can cast Hiemal Strike, Healing Vapours, and Explosive Icicle.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse, creating an undead servant.
itens.descricao: Create a corpse as a heinous mummy that fights by your side.

itens.resumo: It allows casters to deal devastating Force damage to a single target, possibly destroying it completely.
itens.descricao: If the target fails a Dexterity Saving Throw, and the spell reduces it to 0 hit points, it disintegrates into a crumbly ash.

itens.resumo: It allows casters to choose amongst one of three debilitating conditions to impose on a single target.
itens.descricao: Your eyes become black corridors walled in teeth, your gaze capable of inflicting dread, sickness, or putting creatures to sleep.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to repeatedly force enemies asleep.
itens.descricao: Put a creature to Sleeping sleep.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to scare enemies for up to 10 turns.
itens.descricao: Strike Fearful Fear deep into a creature's heart.

itens.resumo: It makes a target deathly sick every turn.
itens.descricao: Afflict a creature with Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

itens.resumo: It allows the caster to Atrophy a foe, Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 1 Restraining them until they temporarily turn to stone.
itens.descricao: Atrophy a foe, Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 1 Restraining them until they temporarily turn to stone.
Create a barrier that makes creatures and objects inside it immune to all damage.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to greatly enfeeble an enemy.
itens.descricao: Reduce a target's maximum hit points, but never below 1.
itens.ao_resistir: Target still takes half damage, but its maximum hit points are not reduced.see bugs

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to substantially heal a target by recovering Hit Points and removing Blinded Blindness and Diseases.
itens.descricao: Heals a target's wounds and remove Blindness and any diseases.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon a bountiful smorgasbord to bolster themselves and their allies and strengthen their resolve.
itens.descricao: You and everyone around can't be Poisoned, Diseased, or Frightened (status group). Everyone's maximum Hit Points increases by 12, and they make Wisdom SavingThrows with Advantage.
Create a vessel for Otiluke's Freezing Sphere (Launch) Otiluke's Freezing Sphere. Put it in your pocket, give it to an ally, or throw it away. It will explode after 10 turn(s).
Create a ball of churning ice that can be launched instantly to generate a frosty explosion or stored for later use.
Launch a ball of churning ice that explodes and damages all creatures and objects within range.
itens.ao_resistir: Targets still take half damage from the explosion.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to force a creature to stay in place, inactive.
itens.descricao: Cause a creature to start dancing, making it unable to take Actions or Move. Its attackers have Advantage on Attack Rolls.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to summon an Elemental, Celestial, or Fiend for aid.
itens.descricao: Beseech one of these otherworldly entities for aid. Summon either an Elemental, Celestial, or Fiend to fight for you.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 6 Conjuration Spell, Planar Ally. It allows spellcasters to summon a Fiend for aid.
itens.descricao: Conjure a Cambion to fight alongside you.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 6 Conjuration Spell, Planar Ally. It allows spellcasters to summon a Celestial for aid.
itens.descricao: Conjure a Celestial Deva to fight alongside you. It can cast Wrathful Smite, Revivify, and Concussive Smash.

itens.resumo: This spell is a variant of the Level 6 Conjuration Spell, Planar Ally. It allows spellcasters to summon an Elemental for aid.
itens.descricao: Conjure a powerful djinni to fight alongside you. It can cast Sweetplum Gales, Thunderwave, and Drunken Inhale.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to project a beam of light, Blinding and dealing Radiant damage to everything in its path. They can then use Recast Sunbeam on subsequent turns without expending a Spell Slot.
itens.descricao: A beam of brilliant light sears and Blinded Blinds all creatures in its path.

itens.resumo: It creates a wall of ice that deals strong Cold damage to anyone nearby.
itens.descricao: Raise a wall of solid ice that deals 10d6 Cold damage to anyone standing in its way.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to conjure a wall of brambles, Entangling and damaging any creatures who are in the area, or trying to pass through.
itens.descricao: Create a wall of pliable, twisting thorns surrounded by Entangled Entangling vines.

itens.resumo: It allows spellcasters to transform a group of allies into a cloud of mist. This form offers damage Resistance, Advantage on some Saving Throws, and the ability to Fly.
itens.descricao: Transform yourself and all nearby party members into tiny clouds of mist to avoid attacks.
